gloss: a woman picking up a man (for a date or hookup)

definitions.gloss: a woman picking up a man (for a date or hookup)
definitions.explanation: A slang term for the reversed version of ナンパ (nampa, a man striking up a pickup with a stranger) — specifically, when a woman approaches a man on the street or in a venue to start a romantic or sexual encounter. The term is often used with a sense of surprise or amusement, since men-initiating is more culturally expected.

examples.english: I got picked up by a woman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧らしい。
examples.english: I hear that the number of women who do reverse pickups is on the rise recently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋谷|しぶや}→渋谷：30632_shibuya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got picked up by a girl in Shibuya and we exchanged contact info.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦びっくりした→びっくりする：01178_bikkurisuru⟧。
examples.english: When I went out drinking with a friend, I was surprised to be picked up by the woman at the table next to us.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (reverse) and the shortened ナン from ⟦ナンパ→ナンパ：09312_nanpa⟧ (pickup; hitting on someone). An example of a common pattern where ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ is prefixed to a word to mean "done in the reverse direction from the usual."

USAGE:
A casual slang word, used mostly in conversation, social media, and entertainment-style media. The verb form is {逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do a reverse pickup) or the passive {逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be picked up by a woman). Not appropriate in formal contexts. Carries a slightly playful or surprised tone because picking up a stranger is traditionally associated with men in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do a reverse pickup (as a woman approaching a man)
- {逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be picked up by a woman
- {逆|ぎゃく}ナン⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: hanging around hoping to be picked up by a woman
- {逆|ぎゃく}ナンスポット: a spot known for women doing reverse pickups

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ナンパ→ナンパ：09312_nanpa⟧: (male-initiated) pickup; hitting on someone on the street — the base word from which this is derived
- ⟦{声|こえ}をかける→声をかける：30589_koewokakeru⟧: to call out to / speak to someone — a neutral phrase; context determines whether it is a pickup
- ⟦{口説|くど}く→口説く：11852_kudoku⟧: to woo; to chat up — focuses on the persuasive talk to win someone over
